description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kehelwala, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad Map No. 320553
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and property registration, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
